text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After classes, I spot Matikanetannhauser
and
Mejiro Palmer on campus trying to
recruit other
students for something.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Come one, come all! Try Machitan and
Palmer's
Love Consultation Center for all
your relationship
needs!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Are you facing your worries alone? Then
it's time
to let out all those pent-up
emotions! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Trainer! Ehehe, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
When I was growing up, I heard all about
the ins
and outs of life from customers at
our restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So leave all your romantic troubles to
me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And I thought it sounded fun, so here I
am!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me... Is now a good time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, welcome! Of course! You can talk to
us about
anything. Don't be shy.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um... The thing is, I'm in a long-distance

relationship...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Long-distance, you say? That's a
very
common dilemma.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
When you're apart, I'm sure your mind
starts to
run wild with all kinds of
worries.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That's right. It's so lonely not being able
to see
each other... I just don't know
what to do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. It's rough not being able to
see the
people you want to, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Tannhauser? Any
useful
advice for her?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Certainly! Allow me to recount a
personal
anecdote!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
See, sometimes I want to eat my family's
grilled
mackerel set so bad I can hardly
stand it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Uh... grilled mackerel?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But of course I can't just go back home
whenever
I want. So I have to stay strong
and hold out until
my next visit!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Then, when I do finally get to eat it, all
the
waiting makes it a million times more
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: In other words, if your longing is at 100%, then when you finally eat—I mean—meet, your happiness will jump to over 200%!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Pft... Pffft, ahahaha! Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh man, ahahaha! You're comparing a

long-distance relationship to grilled
mackerel?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did I say something weird?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No, nothing weird. It was just funny!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Strangely enough, I actually can
relate to
your story.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
The more time apart, the more joy I'll
feel when
we meet again... Hehe, I get it.
Instead of feeling
lonely, I should be
thinking about how exciting
it'll be!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Seems like it was good advice,
after all.
Great job, Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heh. Leave the relationship advice
to me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heh. Leave the relationship advice
to me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Gah... All this talk of food is making me
hungry.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Even if I can't have grilled mackerel, I
need to eat
something!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then let's head to a cafe! Nothing better
for
cheering up than a full stomach. ♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three of them enjoy a meal while
diving into
more relationship talk.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Let's keep this momentum
going and
help even more people solve
their problems!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You know, your methods might be
unusual, but I
think they'll really catch
on!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! Over there! I sense someone with
love
troubles!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser spends the day
roaming the
academy grounds on the
lookout for students
with romantic
troubles!
